scope: One Node file (Node 22+ for the global WebSocket, built-in modules only) that starts headless Chromium or Firefox for tests on a free port with a private temporary profile, a deadline on every wait and a guaranteed kill on exit; Firefox is driven over WebDriver BiDi with Chrome's protocol shape. Two offline test files use stand-in browsers; real-Firefox tests skip where none is installed. No dependencies, fonts or images are bundled. Earlier component approvals do not apply.

source.name: isolated-browser-launcher (extracted from a private repository; the public files were stripped of project-specific names and carry no history)

not_imported: project-specific names, paths and issue numbers

derivations.browser-launch.mjs: Removed a product-specific default preload (a storage key and its helper) and replaced it by a generic preloadScript option, none by default, so a launch that passes no preloadScript preloads nothing (the private launcher preloaded one product choice by default); removed issue numbers and names of sibling files from the header and comments; renamed the temporary-directory prefix. The launch, kill, deadline and BiDi translation code is otherwise unchanged.
derivations.tests/launch.test.mjs: Renamed from the private test; imports adjusted; the two small helpers it took from a sibling module are inlined; issue and file references removed.
derivations.tests/firefox.test.mjs: Renamed from the private test; imports adjusted; the preload cases rewritten for the generic preloadScript option with neutral values; the exception-text helper inlined; issue, lane and sibling-file references, product-specific route strings, ports and view names replaced by neutral examples.
